defs.def: to get well again after being ill/sick, hurt, etc. 恢复健康；康复；痊愈

ex.s: Curtin is CEO of DC Central Kitchen in Washington, D.C., which recovers food and turns it into healthy meals.
ex.t: Curtin是华盛顿特区DC Central Kitchen的首席执行官，该公司回收食物并将其转化为健康餐食。

ex.s: Hospital patients Who see tree branches out their window are likely to recover at a faster rate than patients who see buildings or sky instead.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 能从窗户看到树枝的医院病人康复速度可能比看到建筑物或天空的病人更快。

ex.s: Fast-forward to the present, an economy has not fully recovered.
ex.t: 对于那些刚进入职场的人来说尤其重要。

ex.s: This brief visit with Mother Nature cost me two days off from work, recovering from a bad case of sunburn and the doctor’s bill for my son’s food poisoning.
ex.t: 这次与大自然的短暂接触让我请了两天假，从严重的晒伤中恢复，还要支付儿子食物中毒的医药费。

ex.s: They are required    63    (process) the food that we eat, to recover from injury and for several other bodily functions.
ex.t: 它们是____（处理）我们所吃的食物、从伤病中恢复以及其他多种身体功能所必需的。

ex.s: recover from her sadness          B. move out of the neighborhood
ex.t: 白大褂让人联想到科学家，而科学家被认为注重细节。

defs.def: to return to a normal state after an unpleasant or unusual experience or a period of difficulty 复原；恢复常态

ex.s: Most of Ho’s students will recover, which means that preparing them to return to school is an increasingly important component of care.
ex.t: 选择读什么书变得更容易了。

defs.def: to get back the same amount of money that you have spent or that is owed to you 全额收回；追回

ex.s: When I recovered from the shock, I looked at my camera.
ex.t: 当我从震惊中恢复过来时，我看了看我的相机。

ex.s: As his hearing got worse and worse, doctors sent him to the village of Heiligenstadt, near Vienna, in the hope that he would recover.
ex.t: 随着他的听力越来越差，医生们把他送到维也纳附近的海利根施塔特村，希望他能康复。

ex.s: She is determined to live a fulfilling life regardless of what the future holds, and to try her best to help patients with this cancer recover in spite of the various difficulties she might face.
ex.t: 她决心无论未来怎样，都要过充实的生活，并尽最大努力帮助患这种癌症的病人康复，不管她可能会面临各种困难。

ex.s: The antelope population has recovered and in June 2015, the Tibetan antelope was removed from the endangered species list.
ex.t: 羚羊种群已经恢复，2015年6月，藏羚羊从濒危物种名单中被移除。

ex.s: They can be kept in an animal rescue centre for some time until they recover.
ex.t: 它们可以在动物救助中心待一段时间，直到康复。

defs.def: to get back or find sth that was lost, stolen or missing 找回；寻回；找到
to win back a position, level, status, etc. that has been lost 赢回；重新获得
to get back the use of your senses, control of your emotions, etc. 恢复；重新控制
